source.label: 현대 공식 도면·사진 기반 정밀 제작
source.configuration: Korea Porter II LPG extra-long super cab, 5155 mm with bumper guard, 2640 mm wheelbase, 1740 × 1970 mm; 2860 × 1630 × 355 mm drop-side bed. Remappable 3D cab paint; simulated engines may differ.
source.limitations: Independently authored curved mesh measured from official dimension drawings; not manufacturer CAD, scan or multi-view photogrammetry. Rounded rear shoulders and pressed channels are inferred from the official rear reference. Calibrated photos supply glass, lamps and selected small details; photographed body shadows are excluded from cab paint. Roof, unseen underbody and cargo interior are inferred; opposite side reuses the available side reference.
